grades: Girls who have completed their junior year of high school
name: Georgia Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Georgia
what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Girls run a pretend state government. They hold elections, write bills and hear guest speakers. You learn how city, county and state government work.
who_can_apply: Girls who finished junior year. You need high moral character and above-average school standing. An American Legion Auxiliary unit must sponsor you. Another group that a unit approves can sponsor you too. Each high school is limited to 12 girls.
pay_detail: $350.00 registration fee, usually paid by the sponsoring unit or organization. The page says sponsors are listed for each girl.
duration: About one week. 2027 session is June 13 to 18, 2027, at Valdosta State University.
deadline_text: 2027 cycle: fee due April 20, 2027. Applications complete by May 25, 2027. The opening date is not posted. The Selection Criteria page was not rechecked, so ask your unit.
how_to_apply: Contact the unit president or Girls State Chairman of a local American Legion Auxiliary unit. This is how you get sponsored. A selection committee picks the girls. Then the application is completed online. The school checks that you are eligible before school ends. Email georgiagirlsstate@gmail.com or call 678-289-8446.
notes: Girls only. The site shows 2027 dates but the 'I Want In' page says last updated 12/3/2022, so confirm with your unit before relying on the dates. Not a paid job, so no work permit.
